description: Poll a background job started by search_areas, enrich_leads, enroll_leads (kind "enrich"), find_contacts or verify_emails. Pass the job id and its kind. Long jobs are normal: a grid search works through many map points, and enrichment fetches every website in the batch.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the starting tool

kind.description: Which tool started it: search (search_areas), enrich (enrich_leads, enroll_leads), contacts (find_contacts), verify (verify_emails)

name: get_job_status
title: Check a background job
